then.text: The flamingo census is on the wall. Your name is at the bottom, in small print, where the real heroes go.
You've caught a Brineling and beaten the Flamingo Warden? That's the whole census done. Here, a feather from the lake, and some supplies from the Centre cupboard.

else.text: A Brineling in your Ark, lovely. Now the Flamingo Warden at the lake wants to meet you in a fair match. He says flamingos are not for sharing.

then.text: A Brineling! Look at the pink on it. That's the shrimp. You've done the hard part: now the Flamingo Warden at the lake wants a word.

else.text: I need you to catch a Brineling on the lake shore. They stand on one leg in the shallows. Bring one back, and don't scare the flock.

then.text: Walk out to the lake and see what you can catch.

else.text: Welcome to the Akrotiri Environmental Centre. The lake is our job: the flamingos, the ducks, the waders and the one very confused heron.
We're counting this winter's birds, and I'm short of hands. Could you catch a Brineling out on the shore? It's the little pink one.

akr_centre_birder.text: Winter is the best time. You get thousands of flamingos on the lake, and the whole shore smells like a very expensive pond.
The flamingos' pink colour comes from what they eat. A flamingo that eats nothing but toast goes white. I've never tested it.
